row.body: The spare key is tagged for the address but the transfer sheet has no receiving signature. Someone has checked the box marked “delivered.”
row.title: Empty address line

sidecar.gloss: A key transfer is marked complete despite the missing recipient.
sidecar.rival_reading: A routine property transfer could leave the same gap; the checked box does not say who was supposed to receive the key.

row.body: the stapler and first-aid kit were sealed together but never opened. soot darkens the bundle; clean outlines show it was packed before the fire.
row.title: missing count beside the stapler

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
